ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and flag the driver's account for review of misuse of the "I'm Here" arrival button.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup and that the rider never showed up. GPS shows he remained ~0.7 km from Bugis Junction throughout the wait and never entered the 200 m pickup radius, so the NS-1 (ii) location requirement fails; system records override the statement.
